title: XOR Exclusive-OR Gate (IC 7486)
summary: An XOR gate (Exclusive-OR) produces a HIGH (1) output IF AND ONLY IF the inputs are DIFFERENT (one is 1, the other is 0). It forms the core of binary adders and parity checkers.

images.title: Breadboard Placement (IC 7486)
images.caption: IC 7486 Quad 2-Input XOR Gate on breadboard.

working_principle: The XOR gate evaluates Y = A ⊕ B = A·B' + A'·B. When inputs are equal (00 or 11), output is 0. When inputs differ (01 or 10), output is 1.
applications: Half Adder and Full Adder Sum Computation
Parity Generator and Parity Checker Networks
Controllable Inverter (Tie one input to HIGH to invert the other)
advantages: Can act as a programmable controlled inverter
common_mistakes: Expecting output 1 when both inputs are 1 (That is standard OR logic, XOR outputs 0 when inputs match!).
quick_notes: Pin 14 is VCC (+5V), Pin 7 is GND.

viva_questions.q: What is the Boolean expression for an XOR gate?
How can an XOR gate act as a Controlled Inverter?
viva_questions.a: Tie input B to 1 (+5V). Then Y = A ⊕ 1 = A', acting as a NOT gate.

interview_questions.q: How many NAND gates are required to construct an XOR gate?
